title: TranscriptLine

DecisionAnswerRecord.description: One question's answer, as the AI SDK returns it.

DecisionFileRecord.description: A file part of a decision's state as it's recorded: its bytes' hash and size instead of the bytes, and the capture it is, when it's one of the attempt's.

capture.description: The `c.capture()` name whose PNG this is.

url.description: A URL the provider was sent instead of bytes, masked.

DecisionRecord.description: One `c.decide()` call, masked as it was sent: a step of the task, never graded and never part of the agent's usage or cost.

answers.description: Each question's answer, by id; empty when the call failed.

costUsd.description: What the gateway says the call cost, in US dollars; unset when it names none.

error.description: Why the call failed, after the AI SDK's retries.

gateway.description: The gateway from the config's `gateway` list the call went through; unset for a model object.

questions.description: The questions, by id, as the AI SDK takes them.

resolvedModel.description: The model id the provider says answered, when it reports one.

state.description: What the model was shown: a string, a JSON object, or parts.

turn.description: How many turns the attempt had sent when it was asked: 0 before the first.

usage.description: Null when the provider reported none, or the call failed.

DecisionStateRecord.description: One part of a decision's state as it's recorded.

TokenUsage.description: The tokens one turn used, as its harness reported them. `input` excludes cache reads and writes (so the prompt was `input + cacheRead + cacheWrite`); `reasoning` is part of `output`.

added.description: Line counts, or null when the harness didn't send the content (e.g. deletes).

durationInferred.description: Set when the harness never reported the call's end, so `durationMs` runs to the next event's `atMs` (the turn's end for the last).

input.description: The tool's input, as a `tool` event's `input`.

kind.description: `write` is a whole-file write whose result doesn't say whether the file existed before (Antigravity's, fx's, Goose's, Grok Build's and pi's write tools, for example).

output.description: The tool's result, as a `tool` event's `output`; absent when the harness never reported one.

outputTruncated.description: Set when `output` is only part of the output, as a `tool` event's `outputTruncated`.

stalled.description: True when a shell-like tool or edit ran at least two minutes.

step.description: The harness's step in its turn the event came in, from 1: a model call where the adapter reports each one (Claude Code, Antigravity, pi; the ACP harnesses' steps end when a call's tools have all returned), the whole turn on Codex and Cursor. Absent when the harness reports no steps, and on `model-call` events.

subagent.description: The `toolCallId` of the subagent call whose agent made this call; absent for the agent's own.

bytes.description: The size of the fetched content the harness reports, in bytes; absent when it reports none.

durationInferred.description: Set when the harness never reported the call's end, so `durationMs` runs to the next event's `atMs` (the turn's end for the last).

input.description: The tool's input, as a `tool` event's `input`.

ok.description: Whether the fetch succeeded; null when the harness never reported its result.

output.description: The tool's result, as a `tool` event's `output`; absent when the harness never reported one.

outputTruncated.description: Set when `output` is only part of the output, as a `tool` event's `outputTruncated`.

status.description: The HTTP status the harness reports for the fetch; absent when it reports none.

input.description: The tool's input. `transcript.jsonl` keeps one whose JSON is past 128K characters as text: its first 96K and last 16K characters, with a line where the rest was cut.

ok.description: Whether the call succeeded; null when the harness never reported its result.

outputTruncated.description: Set when `output` is only part of the output, with a line where the rest was cut: `transcript.jsonl` keeps the first 96K and last 16K characters of one past 128K (of its JSON, for structured output), and the harness adapter keeps the first and last 512 KiB of a saved output past 1 MiB. `bytes` is the whole output's size in UTF-8.

outputView.description: What `output` holds: `model`, the result as the harness gave it to the model; `full`, the tool's whole output, which can be more than the model saw (the harness cut it for the model, or saved it to a file and gave the model a pointer, which reeval read).

subagent.description: The `toolCallId` of the subagent call whose agent said it; absent for the agent's own.

firstByteMs.description: Milliseconds from the call's start to its response body's first byte; null when none came.

model.description: The model that served it, from its request or response; null when neither named one.

request.description: `POST api.anthropic.com/v1/messages`: the method, host and path.

role.description: `main` for one of the agent's own steps, `side` for a call its CLI made around them: a session title, a web search's own model call, Antigravity's Flash Lite calls. A call is `main` when its tokens are one of the turn's steps' as the harness reported them. Otherwise it's `side` when its request declared at most one tool while another call in the attempt declared more, or when another model served it than served the turn's other calls, and `main` when neither holds. Absent in records from before roles.

status.description: The response's HTTP status; null when none came.

step.description: The harness's step in its turn the event came in, from 1: a model call where the adapter reports each one (Claude Code, Antigravity, pi; the ACP harnesses' steps end when a call's tools have all returned), the whole turn on Codex and Cursor. Absent when the harness reports no steps, and on `model-call` events.

stream.description: Set on a call that carries the whole turn (Cursor's), so it isn't counted as model time.

usage.description: The tokens its response body named; null when it named none (Cursor's are protobuf).
